description:
Wait for the human to send something back to this session — texts and
    voicemail transcripts arrive here. Long-polls up to wait_s (max 30s);
    returns {events, cursor}. Pass the returned cursor next time to only see
    new events. An empty events list just means nothing yet — poll again if
    you are still waiting.

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous result; 0 the first time.
cursor.title: Cursor

session_token.description: The session_token from an earlier result. It keeps every call and text in one thread on their phone.
session_token.title: Session Token

wait_s.description: How long to wait for something to arrive, 0 to 30 seconds.
wait_s.title: Wait S

name: wait_for_reply

id.description: Event id; the cursor moves past it.
id.title: Id

payload.description: The event's content, e.g. the message body.
payload.title: Payload

type.description: What arrived, e.g. a text or a voicemail.
type.title: Type

cursor.description: Pass back as cursor next time to see only newer events.
cursor.title: Cursor

events.description: New events since the cursor; empty means nothing yet.
events.title: Events

title: Wait for a text reply
